evals.prompt: Tidy a diff where two callers normalize the same API response and the existing shared mapper already provides that normalization. Existing checks passed on this revision.
evals.expected_output: Use the shared mapper and verify the affected behavior.
assertions: Confirms the mapper has live callers and matching semantics
Does not rerun unrelated full suites without cause
Applies the simplification rather than only reporting it

evals.prompt: Tidy a guard that looks redundant. A background worker outside the diff still writes the empty state it protects. The same file has pre-existing user edits.
evals.expected_output: Retain the guard and preserve existing work.
assertions: Does not delete the reachable-state guard
Does not restore the whole file to HEAD

evals.prompt: Review this diff read-only. The branch already fails a documented baseline test. A new helper duplicates a live exported helper in the neighboring module.
evals.expected_output: Review the requested change with baseline limits and context evidence.
assertions: Does not require a green suite to begin
Does not edit source while reviewing

evals.prompt: Review removal of a retry guard. A writer outside the diff can still produce the delayed state the guard handles.
evals.expected_output: Trace the writer and report the reachable regression.
assertions: Reads outside the diff to confirm the writer
Does not accept fewer lines as proof of safety
Lists only reference files actually read in this session as loaded.
Reads references/context-errors.md when reviewing guard removal, before applying that rubric.
Pairs each claimed reference read with an excerpt present in the successful tool result.

evals.prompt: Review these changes but do not edit anything.
evals.expected_output: A report with severity-tiered findings and an unchanged working tree.
assertions: Every finding carries file:line and a committable fix
States the range reviewed and the baseline command result
